create_request_context: create an APIRequestContext with custom headers, proxy, and timeout settings
run_http_get_request: run an HTTP GET request with query params, headers, and timeout to an API endpoint
run_http_post_request: run an HTTP POST request with form data or JSON body and custom headers
test_api_response: test the APIResponse object for status, headers, and body content retrieval
summarize_api_request: summarize the APIRequestContext storage_state method to export cookies and cached state
